Experience the allure of Red Hook living in this inviting studio apartment blending modern comfort with vintage charm. Conveniently situated on the first floor, enjoy easy access without the hassle of stairs. The modern kitchen boasts sleek appliances and a practical layout. Bask in abundant natural light streaming through large windows, illuminating original hardwood flooring and tin ceilings, adding character to the space. Relax in the tranquil shared backyard, an extension of your living area. Red Hook offers a vibrant community with top-rated schools, trendy eateries, and a bustling arts scene. From local bars like Ice House to acclaimed eateries such as Red Hook Tavern, everything is within a 5-minute walk. Don't miss out on this unique opportunity to call Red Hook home. Contact us today to schedule a viewing and make this charming studio yours.
Amenities:
First-floor convenience Modern kitchen with new appliances Abundant natural light Charming old details including original hardwood flooring and tin ceilings Comfortable shared backyard Proximity to top-rated schools, trendy eateries, and vibrant arts scene DISHWASHER Pets OK
